title: Design File System
summary: Design a path-to-value store with createPath(path, value) and get(path). A path is created only if it does not already exist and its immediate parent exists, with top-level paths using the implicit root; a failed creation creates nothing. get returns the stored value or -1.
inputFormat: createPath takes a path string and an integer value; get takes a path string.
outputFormat: get returns the integer value or -1. The return value of createPath is not recorded in the draft.
edgeRules: A failed creation must not create intermediate paths (stated in the draft).

examples.label: authored-reference
examples.output: createPath returns true, true, false; get returns 2 and -1
examples.note: Conditional on createPath returning a boolean, which is not recorded.

factsPresent: Create rule (parent must exist, path not present)
factsMissing: Return type of createPath (boolean success flag, or void)
Path string format and value range
questions: Does createPath return a boolean success value, and if so what does it return for a failed creation?
What is the allowed path format and value range?
